title: Grim Reaper and Cosmic Octopus
description: A surreal desert scene features the Grim Reaper in a blue cloak holding a bloody scythe on the left, facing a large green octopus with teal tentacles. A red bird flies toward a robed figure on the right who holds up a white card with a black symbol. The sky contains a giant smiling blue moon with yellow eyes, smaller smiling blue planets, galaxies, and a golden frame dripping red liquid.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with the Grim Reaper in a flowing blue robe holding a bloody scythe standing on rocks, a large green octopus with orange suckers and long teal tentacles in the center, a bright red bird in flight, and a robed wizard-like figure in white and turquoise holding up a card with a black symbol. A giant smiling blue moon with yellow eyes dominates the purple sky along with smaller smiling blue planets, spiral galaxies, and a golden oval frame dripping red liquid from the top, vibrant colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
